redTeam.$comment: statusLabels defaults true (WE_RED_TEAM_STATUS_LABELS override); head-bound derived status only, recorded results remain authoritative. skipCardOnly defaults true; card-only net diffs never schedule a pass.

operatorRulings.$comment: anyState (default true; kill switch WE_RED_TEAM_OPERATOR_RULINGS_ANY_STATE=false): a human operator's record-red-team-ruling may rule card on any confirmed break of the live head's result (at the cap, sent back, or carded). Off = round-cap-only.
